To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
equity return correlations are affected by macroeconomic variables and fundamentals within an industry.
equity return correlations are affected by the macroeconomic conditions of the country and the fundamental factors of the sector.

1) the correlations of equity returns in the Amman Stock Market are time-varying and can be explained by macroeconomic variables and fundamentals; 2) the correlation of equity returns is higher in times of financial crises; 3) the effect of macroeconomic variables and fundamental variables on the comovement of equity returns differs among sectors; 4) macroeconomic variables have the most significant influence on the comovement in the banking sector; and 5) fundamentals within an industry are important
